title.it: Il passato, verbi regolari: I walked

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj se je zgodilo (I walked, she stayed), glagol pravilno napišeš (liked, stopped, carried), ga pravilno izgovoriš in rečeš, kdaj: yesterday, last week, two days ago.
goal.de: Du sagst, was passiert ist (I walked, she stayed), schreibst das Verb richtig (liked, stopped, carried), sprichst es richtig aus und sagst, wann: yesterday, last week, two days ago.
goal.it: Dici che cosa è successo (I walked, she stayed), scrivi bene il verbo (liked, stopped, carried), lo pronunci bene e dici quando: yesterday, last week, two days ago.
goal.en: You can say what happened (I walked, she stayed), spell the verb (liked, stopped, carried), say it right, and say when: yesterday, last week, two days ago.

say.sl: Za kar se je končalo v času, ki je mimo, dodaš glagolu **-ed**, za vse osebe enako: **I walked**, **she walked**, **they walked** (hodil{m:|f:a} sem, hodila je, hodili so). Je ena sama beseda, brez pomožnika: **I worked** (delal{m:|f:a} sem). Nikoli *I am walked*.
say.de: Für etwas Abgeschlossenes in einer Zeit, die vorbei ist, bekommt das Verb **-ed**, für alle Personen gleich: **I walked**, **she walked**, **they walked** (ich ging, sie ging, sie gingen). Es ist ein Wort, ohne Hilfsverb, auch wo das Deutsche das Perfekt nimmt: **I worked** (ich habe gearbeitet). Nie *I am walked*.
say.it: Per una cosa finita, in un tempo passato, il verbo prende **-ed**, uguale per tutte le persone: **I walked**, **she walked**, **they walked** (ho camminato, ha camminato, hanno camminato). È una parola sola, senza ausiliare, anche dove l'italiano dice *ho lavorato*: **I worked**. Mai *I am walked*.
say.en: For something finished, at a time that is over, add **-ed** to the verb, the same for every person: **I walked**, **she walked**, **they walked**. It is one word, with no helping verb: **I worked**. Never *I am walked*.

say.sl: Z njim gredo besede za čas, ki je mimo: **yesterday** (včeraj), **last night** (sinoči), **last week** (prejšnji teden), **two days ago** (pred dvema dnevoma), **in 1952** (leta 1952). **ago** stoji za časom: **two days ago**, nikoli *ago two days*.
say.de: Dazu passen Wörter für eine Zeit, die vorbei ist: **yesterday** (gestern), **last night** (gestern Abend), **last week** (letzte Woche), **two days ago** (vor zwei Tagen), **in 1952** (1952). **ago** steht hinter der Zeit: **two days ago**, nie *ago two days*.
say.it: Con questo tempo vanno le parole di un tempo finito: **yesterday** (ieri), **last night** (ieri sera), **last week** (la settimana scorsa), **two days ago** (due giorni fa), **in 1952** (nel 1952). **ago** va dopo il tempo, come *fa*: **two days ago**, mai *ago two days*.
say.en: It goes with words for a time that is over: **yesterday**, **last night**, **last week**, **two days ago**, **in 1952**. **ago** comes after the time: **two days ago**, never *ago two days*.

say.sl: Pravopis: glagol na **-e** dobi samo **-d**: like → **liked**. Kratek glagol z enim samoglasnikom in enim soglasnikom ga podvoji: stop → **stopped**, plan → **planned** (načrtoval); ne w, x, y: snow → **snowed**. Britansko je **travelled**, ameriško traveled.
say.de: Zur Schreibung: Ein Verb auf **-e** bekommt nur **-d**: like → **liked**. Ein kurzes Verb mit einem Vokal und einem Konsonanten verdoppelt ihn: stop → **stopped**, plan → **planned** (plante); nicht w, x, y: snow → **snowed**. Britisch **travelled**, amerikanisch traveled.
say.it: L'ortografia: un verbo in **-e** prende solo **-d**: like → **liked**. Un verbo breve con una vocale e una consonante la raddoppia: stop → **stopped**, plan → **planned** (ha organizzato); non w, x, y: snow → **snowed**. In britannico **travelled**, in americano traveled.
say.en: Spelling: a verb in **-e** takes only **-d**: like → **liked**. A short verb with one vowel and one consonant doubles it: stop → **stopped**, plan → **planned**; not w, x, y: snow → **snowed**. British **travelled**, American traveled.

say.sl: Soglasnik + **-y** postane **-ied**: carry → **carried**, try → **tried**, study → **studied**. Samoglasnik + **-y** ostane in dobi **-ed**: stay → **stayed**, play → **played**, enjoy → **enjoyed**.
say.de: Konsonant + **-y** wird **-ied**: carry → **carried**, try → **tried**, study → **studied**. Vokal + **-y** bleibt und bekommt **-ed**: stay → **stayed**, play → **played**, enjoy → **enjoyed**.
say.it: Consonante + **-y** diventa **-ied**: carry → **carried**, try → **tried**, study → **studied**. Vocale + **-y** resta e prende **-ed**: stay → **stayed**, play → **played**, enjoy → **enjoyed**.
say.en: Consonant + **-y** becomes **-ied**: carry → **carried**, try → **tried**, study → **studied**. Vowel + **-y** stays and takes **-ed**: stay → **stayed**, play → **played**, enjoy → **enjoyed**.

say.sl: **-ed** ima tri glasove. Za p, k, s, ch, sh, f zveni kot t: **walked**, **helped**, **washed**. Za večino drugih kot d: **played**, **opened**, **lived**. Le za t in d je svoj zlog, id: **wanted**, **started**, **mended**. **walked** ima torej en sam zlog.
say.de: **-ed** klingt auf drei Arten. Nach p, k, s, ch, sh, f wie t: **walked**, **helped**, **washed**. Nach den meisten anderen wie d: **played**, **opened**, **lived**. Nur nach t und d ist es eine eigene Silbe, id: **wanted**, **started**, **mended**. **walked** hat also nur eine Silbe.
say.it: **-ed** ha tre suoni. Dopo p, k, s, ch, sh, f suona t: **walked**, **helped**, **washed**. Dopo la maggior parte degli altri suona d: **played**, **opened**, **lived**. Solo dopo t e d è una sillaba a sé, id: **wanted**, **started**, **mended**. **walked** ha quindi una sola sillaba.
say.en: **-ed** has three sounds. After p, k, s, ch, sh, f it sounds like t: **walked**, **helped**, **washed**. After most others, like d: **played**, **opened**, **lived**. Only after t and d is it a syllable of its own, id: **wanted**, **started**, **mended**. So **walked** has one syllable.

say.it: Alcuni verbi in britannico hanno anche **-t**: **learnt** o **learned**, **burnt** o **burned**, **dreamt** (ha sognato) o **dreamed**. Sono giusti tutti e due. In americano si scrive **-ed**.
say.en: A few verbs also have **-t** in British English: **learnt** or **learned**, **burnt** or **burned**, **dreamt** or **dreamed**. Both are right. American English has **-ed**.

summary.sl: **Pravilni preteklik: glagol + -ed**, za vse osebe enako, brez pomožnika: **I walked**, **she stayed**. Pravopis: **liked**, **stopped**, **carried**, a **stayed**. S časom, ki je mimo: **yesterday**, **last week**, **two days ago**.
summary.de: **Regelmäßige Vergangenheit: Verb + -ed**, für alle Personen gleich, ohne Hilfsverb: **I walked**, **she stayed**. Schreibung: **liked**, **stopped**, **carried**, aber **stayed**. Mit einer Zeit, die vorbei ist: **yesterday**, **last week**, **two days ago**.
summary.it: **Passato regolare: verbo + -ed**, uguale per tutte le persone, senza ausiliare: **I walked**, **she stayed**. Ortografia: **liked**, **stopped**, **carried**, ma **stayed**. Con un tempo finito: **yesterday**, **last week**, **two days ago**.
summary.en: **The regular past: verb + -ed**, the same for every person, no helping verb: **I walked**, **she stayed**. Spelling: **liked**, **stopped**, **carried**, but **stayed**. With a time that is over: **yesterday**, **last week**, **two days ago**.

In the evening Sam ___ (play) the fiddle and everyone ___ (dance). It ___ (rain) all night, and the guests ___ (stay) until Tuesday. At ten the bus ___ (stop) by the inn.

translation.sl: Prejšnji ponedeljek je bil v gostilni Packhorse naporen dan. Gospa Birkett je kuhala za dvajset gostov. Harry je nosil krožnike, Poppy pa je pospravljala mize. Zvečer je Sam igral na violino in vsi so plesali. Vso noč je deževalo in gostje so ostali do torka. Ob desetih se je pri gostilni ustavil avtobus.
translation.de: Letzten Montag war im Gasthaus Packhorse viel los. Mrs Birkett hat für zwanzig Gäste gekocht. Harry hat die Teller getragen, und Poppy hat die Tische sauber gemacht. Am Abend hat Sam Geige gespielt, und alle haben getanzt. Es hat die ganze Nacht geregnet, und die Gäste sind bis Dienstag geblieben. Um zehn hat der Bus beim Gasthaus gehalten.
translation.it: Lunedì scorso alla locanda Packhorse c'era molto da fare. La signora Birkett ha cucinato per venti ospiti. Harry ha portato i piatti e Poppy ha pulito i tavoli. La sera Sam ha suonato il violino e tutti hanno ballato. Ha piovuto tutta la notte e gli ospiti sono rimasti fino a martedì. Alle dieci l'autobus si è fermato davanti alla locanda.
translation.en: Last Monday was a busy day at the Packhorse Inn. Mrs Birkett cooked for twenty guests. Harry carried the plates, and Poppy cleaned the tables. In the evening Sam played the fiddle and everyone danced. It rained all night, and the guests stayed until Tuesday. At ten the bus stopped by the inn.
